reviewer: Codex technical geometry routing review; not user final appearance approval

notes.routing_outcome: Suitable as a high-density sculpt source for production rebuild.
notes.eyes: Clean semantic oval pads exist without ghost doubles, but authored eye geometry and controlled catchlights must replace them.
notes.mouth: The closed seam is readable and not collapsed, but it is angular. Rebuild the muzzle, lip loops, mouth bag, and tongue during retopology; do not preserve this seam as final topology.
notes.horns: Primary horn volumes are intact and separated. Mild left-right shape asymmetry should be corrected during retopology.
notes.surface: Broad forms are substantially cleaner than P1. Minor generated surface rippling should be smoothed during the production rebuild.
notes.approval_scope: This passes only the source-sculpt routing gate. Final materials, appearance, rigging, and animation remain unapproved.
